newsitem.title: USA: Zeigler bid joined by Southern unit.
newsitem.headline: Zeigler bid joined by Southern unit.

text.p: Zeigler Coal Holding Co said Tuesday that Southern Electric International Inc, a Southern Co affiliate, has joined in the offer by NRG Energy and Zeigler to buy non-nuclear assets of Cajun Electric Power Cooperative Inc of Baton Rouge, La.
NRG Energy is the non-regulated affiliate of Minneapolis-based Northern States Power Co.
The newly combined offer was incorporated in an amended plan filed Monday by the Cajun trustee in bankruptcy court.
Under the plan, the assets would be acquired by Louisiana Generating LLC, which would be owned by affiliates of Southern Electric, NRG Energy and Zeigler.
A Zeigler subsidiary has supplied nearly all of the coal provided to Cajun since 1982.
